Players Committee card image of [[First Light: Bar]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “'''Light Side:''' Force drain -1 here (if your musician here, Force drain +1 instead).” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/First%20Light%20Bar.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/First Light Bar.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
